name: Exp_ZPF
summary: This EA trades based on the ZPF (Zero-Phase Filter) custom indicator, entering long when the indicator crosses above zero and short when it crosses below zero. It uses customizable smoothing methods and price types to generate trend-following signals with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ZPF（零相位滤波器）自定义指标进行交易，当指标从零轴下方向上穿越时做多，从零轴上方向下穿越时做空。它使用可配置的平滑方法和价格类型生成趋势跟踪信号，并设置固定的止损止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ZPF指标的趋势跟踪，ZPF指标是一种经过平滑处理的零轴振荡器，当指标值从负转正时产生买入信号，从正转负时产生卖出信号。入场条件方面，做多需要指标前一根柱值大于0且当前柱值从0以下上穿，做空则相反。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈点数，以及当反向信号出现时平仓（如做多时指标转负则平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，支持基于账户余额的比例仓位调整。该策略支持多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等）和多种价格类型，提供了较大的参数优化空间。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on the ZPF indicator, which is a smoothed zero-line oscillator that generates buy signals when crossing above zero and sell signals when crossing below zero. Entry conditions require the indicator value to be positive on the signal bar while being zero or negative on the previous bar for buys, and vice versa for sells. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, as well as counter-signal exits where a long position is closed when the indicator turns negative. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management is implemented through the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting balance-proportional position adjustment. The strategy supports multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, etc.) and multiple price types, providing a large parameter optimization space.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为固定手数

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.description: 第一次平滑参数（JJMA范围-100到+100）
parameters.description_en: 第一次平滑参数（JJMA范围-100到+100）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的柱索引
parameters.description_en: 获取入场信号的柱索引

pros: 支持多种平滑算法和价格类型，参数灵活性高，适合不同市场环境优化
具有完整的止损止盈机制和双向交易权限控制，风险管理基本完善
使用新柱检测机制避免同一K柱内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
pros_en: Supports multiple smoothing algorithms and price types with high parameter flexibility, suitable for optimization across different market conditions
Has complete stop loss/take profit mechanism and bidirectional trade permission controls, with basically sound risk management
Uses new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same candle, reducing overtrading risk
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR），在不同波动环境下可能不适用
缺乏加仓、减仓和移动止损（追踪止损）功能，无法在趋势中锁定利润
指标句柄创建失败时仅打印警告但未终止初始化，可能导致后续交易逻辑异常
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit are fixed point values without considering market volatility (ATR), which may be unsuitable across different volatility environments
Lacks position scaling, partial close, and trailing stop functionality, unable to lock in profits during trending moves
Indicator handle creation failure only prints a warning without terminating initialization, which may cause abnormal trading logic subsequently
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制，使风险管理适应市场波动率变化
添加移动止损（追踪止损）功能，在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit mechanism to adapt risk management to market volatility changes
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trending markets

risk_points: 指标句柄创建失败时未返回INIT_FAILED，EA仍继续运行可能导致无信号交易
固定止损止盈不适应不同波动率的市场环境，可能在低波动时止损过宽或高波动时止盈过小
risk_points_en: Indicator handle creation failure does not return INIT_FAILED, EA continues running which may lead to signal-less trading
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adapt to different volatility market environments, possibly too wide in low volatility or too tight in high volatility
